purpose: Refuse a commit whose message has no `Claude-Session:` trailer with a value (`wsc policy --commit-msg`; git reads a trailer only in the last paragraph, with Co-Authored-By); silent unless the repo sets `[policy] commit_msg_hook = true`.
usage: git config core.hooksPath .githooks   (in a game repo with the core at core/: core/.githooks), then opt in with `[policy] commit_msg_hook = true` in wsc.toml. Fix a refusal with git commit --trailer "Claude-Session: <session id>"; a human commit bypasses once with git commit --no-verify.
when: automatic on every git commit (git passes the message file); merge commits are skipped.
not_a_verb: git runs hooks by file name; this one only calls `wsc policy --commit-msg`.
